subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept google-vertex ADC onboarding as a permissive request-time auth contract with setup-written project/location/default model and a non-secret marker profile?
rationale: The PR fixes a real Google Vertex setup gap, but it changes provider auth detection, setup defaults, marker credential semantics, and fallback routing in compatibility-sensitive areas that require maintainer product intent.

options.title: Accept ADC setup contract
options.body: Land after the docs-map repair with maintainers explicitly owning request-time invalid-ADC failures, the global/default-model onboarding writes, and the core fallback routing.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep or reintroduce stricter setup evidence, reduce default config writes, or add an explicit strict path before accepting the onboarding behavior.

options.title: Pause behind Vertex cluster
options.body: Hold this PR until #60736, #60860, and adjacent location/model routing work settle the permanent Google Vertex contract.

recommendation.title: Accept ADC setup contract
recommendation.body: Land after the docs-map repair with maintainers explicitly owning request-time invalid-ADC failures, the global/default-model onboarding writes, and the core fallback routing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the most relevant recent Vertex/provider-routing PRs and is the clearest visible decision router for whether this compatibility-sensitive contract should land.
